text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, while Mejiro Dober and I<n>are having a
meeting in my office...
Sorry to interrupt. Trainer, do you<n>have a minute?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I came to deliver good news!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober, the URA has selected<n>you as the
senior-year Goddess!<n>Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The title of Goddess is awarded to<n>those who run in
races like the<n>Hanshin J.F., Triple Tiara, and Queen
Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The accolade is awarded to one racer<n>in each year:
junior, classic, and<n>senior. It's a huge honor for
Mejiro<n>Dober to be selected to represent her<n>year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Me... the senior-year Goddess!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I did it!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! ♪ The award<n>ceremony is going to
be held in a few<n>days, so don't forget to prepare a
speech!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you'll have quite the<n>audience. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Understood.
choice_data_list:
We'd better give them a speech befitting your new
title!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't agree more. We have our<n>work cut out
for us.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The day of the award ceremony<n>arrives in the blink
of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober successfully gives her<n>speech
without the slightest stumble!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text:
She's fully established her new<n>identity, hasn't
she? She has the<n>bearing of a newly crowned
queen.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
She does! I can't even begin to<n>guess what great
feats she'll be<n>accomplishing from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Behold, a gift! One of your<n>underclassmen has
prepared a<n>bouquet of flowers for you!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: C-congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: U-um! I-I just wanted to say...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: I really look up to you!

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text:
I'm training really, really hard so I can<n>be just like
you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You don't have to try to become like<n>me, though.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You have your own light inside<n>yourself. Keep
working hard, but work<n>hard as yourself and
nobody else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to racing against<n>you—the you
that only you can<n>be—someday.

text_block_list.name: Younger Student
text_block_list.text: Wow... Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: W-well, it's certainly not me! It's<n>just...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oops, am I smiling? I didn't realize.<n>But I am happy.
After all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: She said she looks up to me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: She said she looks up to me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I have to work hard as well so I can<n>remain an
inspiration for her, the way<n>Air Groove was an
inspiration for me!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober's incredible<n>accomplishments are
evident to<n>everyone as the award ceremony<n>comes
to an end!
